name: Module Flashcards
description: Review terms learned throughout the modules using flashcards
instructions: Flip the flashcard to reveal the definition or term

name: Central Dogma Codon Slider
description: Using a codon slding window, find an open reading frame (ORF) in a DNA sequence and perform transcription and translation
instructions: Find and set the start and stop codons for the ORF
Transcribe the found ORF to the mRNA sequence
Translate the mRNA to the protein amino acid sequence

name: Data Hub Query Builder
description: Use a simple query builder to build a query that finds the given molecule in the database
instructions: Select the correct molecule from the results list

name: Sequence Alignment
description: Use the Needleman-Wunsch algorithm to fill in a sequence alignment matrix and then backtrace the matrix to get the alignment and score
instructions: Fill in the sequence alignment matrix using the Needleman-Wunsch algorithm
Trace the matrix from bottom-right to top-left to get the alignment and score

name: Phylogenetic Tree Building
description: Group the points together to build a phylogenetic tree using the UPGMA algorithm
instructions: Select the correct data point intersection in the distance matrix and group them
Calculate the new distances based on the grouped points

name: Polygenic Risk Lab
description: Find the significant variants in a Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS), view allelic contingency of the variants and calculate their Odds Ratios, and then give a clinical recommendation based on patient profile and Polygenic Risk Score (PRS)
instructions: Set the threshold for the GWAS Manhattan Plot and select the peak
Drag and drop the values from the allelic contingency matrix into the formula to determine the Odds Ratio for a significant variant
Give a clinical recommendation based on the given patient profile

name: Python Scripting
description: Write Python code to execute a bioinformatics algorithm
instructions: Drag and drop the lines of code to create a script that [script function]

name: Docking Best Fit
description: Choose the best ligand for a protein's active binding site and then rotate it for the best fit
instructions: View the details for each ligand and select the best fit
Rotate the ligand for the best binding

name: Pipeline Walkthrough
description: Walk through a bioinformatics pipelines by performing a series of activities
